Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Robert T Goudie <info.cr...@JUNO.COM> writes:
> My group has a question about the play of action modifiers in conjunction
> with the Mask. Say, for example, that Minion A bleeds and after a block
> attempt Minion A plays Lost In Crowds. Minion B plays further intercept
> and then Minion C Masks Minion A's bleed action. Minion B then comes up
> with more intercept.
>
> Minion C cannot play a lost in crowds, right?

He can. The restriction is: A given minion cannot play the same
action modifier more than once during an action.

Switch minions, and the new minion is free to play the same
action modifier as the first (card text allowing, of course -
you can't get around the restriction on the +bleed modifiers
this way, for instance).
